per-cooperation: Peru said fighting impunity required states to enforce sentences, execute warrants and answer assistance requests.
per-unity: Peru urged Council unity behind the Mechanism.
both: Peru urged Council unity behind the Mechanism and tied fighting impunity to states enforcing sentences, executing warrants and answering assistance requests.

rus-staffing: Russia linked its abstention to earlier staffing concerns.
rus-medical: Russia questioned Mladić’s care and recalled requesting temporary release to Russia under Russian guarantees if prison doctors could not treat him.
both: Russia linked its abstention to earlier staffing concerns. It questioned Mladić’s care and sought temporary release to Russia under Russian guarantees if prison doctors could not treat him.

srb-release: Serbia objected that temporary medical release was refused despite its guarantees.
srb-cooperation: Serbia said it met cooperation obligations and pledged war-crime prosecutions regardless of nationality.
both: Serbia protested denial of temporary medical release despite its guarantees, affirmed meeting cooperation obligations and pledged war-crime prosecutions regardless of nationality.
